items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: All they did was take up dancing themselves right here out on the street. That's what they told me now.

ctx.x: Her name is Naomi McGraw, and his name was Herbert Brown. And they had McKinney's cotton pickers. She had, they hired them to travel with her. Naomi and McGraw. She's right from here. Now, here, and they never had any dancing instruction. All they did was take up dancing themselves right here out on the street. That's what they told me now. And, boy, as I know, I never known them to do. Their music and excitement here has a lot to do with some of the, well, I think just New Orleans is a great town for…
Did you say that you worked, that you were on the stage around here before you went to Chicago?
